'''Kursma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] middleweight [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]]. Native to [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]], Kursma traveled the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] on the shockboxing circuit. Against the advice of her manager, she also spent time in between fights acting as hired muscle to various crime lords.
